io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: EnergyAI helps an agent answer a homeowner's energy questions and act on them. Check solar, heat pump, battery and weatherization incentives by state and ZIP, estimate solar production, read 98 plain-language guides, find local installers, and send a homeowner to an independent human review of their installer quote. 34 tools in all: 16 work with no key, 7 more are free with a free key. 11 paid tools, from $0.02 to $1.00 per call, add a full power screen, project roadmaps and installer quote review. Remote server over Streamable HTTP: claude mcp add --transport http energyai https://api.energyaisolution.com/mcp
